high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from "The Leather Chef," an online store specializing in handcrafted leather goods. The top section of the page displays the store's logo, which features a stylized iron with the text "The Leather Chef" underneath it. Below the logo, there is a banner showcasing a product called the "Army Green Compact Zipper Wallet." The banner includes a close-up image of the wallet, highlighting its compact design and zipper feature.
